blocks.text: NEW YORK — Alice Huang, the alleged spy at the center of the Nvidia scandal, was in touch with an official from China’s top spy agency during an affair with the chip giant’s chief executive Jensen Huang, the New York Times reported on Sunday. Alice Huang was outed this month as a suspected Chinese spy, accused of digging up company secrets for Beijing. She was in contact with an officer of China’s Ministry of State Security from the spring of 2025 until the fall of this year, the Times reported, citing people with knowledge of the intelligence.
